title: Location country and time zone values, THE_ prefix and Terraform validation

validator-enum-prefixed.statement: The Terraform provider's validator enum, kept in its source, writes the Netherlands as `THE_NETHERLANDS` for country and `THE_NETHERLANDS_EUROPE_AMSTERDAM` for time zone, while Netherlands Antilles values (`NETHERLANDS_ANTILLES`, `NETHERLANDS_ANTILLES_AMERICA_CURACAO`) are unprefixed.

prefix-is-selective.statement: The `THE_` prefix is applied to country names that carry the English article, not to every country; other such names were not checked.
prefix-is-selective.conditions: Derived from one country's prefixed values against its unprefixed neighbor; the full list was not audited.

validators-removed.statement: Terraform 4.7.18 (April 17, 2026) removed `country` and `tz` validation from `zia_location_management` "to align with recent API changes"; the schema entries are commented out in the source, so the provider no longer rejects either value at plan time.

quotes: Removed `country` and `tz` validation from resource `zia_location_management` to align with recent API changes.

python-sdk-passes-through.statement: The Python SDK's location model copies `tz` and `country` from the response unchanged, so any normalization happens in the API, not the SDK.

quotes: self.tz = config["tz"] if "tz" in config else None
self.country = config["country"] if "country" in config else None

check-which-layer-rejects.statement: Before 4.7.18 a Terraform value outside the validator enum failed at plan time; from 4.7.18 a rejected write comes from the ZIA API itself.
check-which-layer-rejects.conditions: Derived from the removal of the plan-time validator; the API's error text was not captured, so which form it asks for is unknown.

read-form.title: Whether the API now returns country and time zone without the THE_ prefix
read-form.detail: Unverified legacy statement: reads of a Netherlands tenant return `country = NETHERLANDS` and `tz = NETHERLANDS_EUROPE_AMSTERDAM`, as reported in upstream issue tf-zia#562 (closed 2026-04-17), whose reporter wrote that this "used to be THE_NETHERLANDS". The issue is not a registered source. The 4.7.18 changelog ("recent API changes") and the SDK pass-through (python-sdk-passes-through) are consistent with it but do not show the value. Resolve by reading the value from GET /locations on a Netherlands location.

write-form-today.title: Which form of country and tz the write API accepts today
write-form-today.detail: Open question carried from the legacy doc. Scenario A: both forms accepted. Scenario B: only the unprefixed form accepted. Scenario C: only the prefixed form accepted, so read and write differ for the same key and apply fails. The legacy note reported scenario C originally; no source shows which holds now. Also unverified for other 'the'-article countries (Bahamas, Gambia, Philippines): only Netherlands was observed. The ZTC provider validator lists unprefixed values, but that is another product's provider and says nothing about ZIA. Resolve by writing each form to a test location.
write-form-today.blocks: advising whether Python-read to Terraform-apply pipelines need value normalization
